problem_statement: Reject negative Content-Length before reading a request body while retaining positive-length limits and normal parsing when the header is absent.
notes: The reference patch is the upstream implementation change under Apache-2.0 in LICENSE.upstream.
The original MIT-licensed evaluation oracle uses a 15-byte in-memory stream and confirms rejection before any bytes are consumed.
Only TestHelperFunctions and TestParseOptionsHeader from tests/test_multipart.py plus the external oracle are selected; large bodies and concurrent memory pressure are outside this case.
